ayahs.4: Aur jab qabrein (shaqq kar ke) ukhaad di jaaengi.
ayahs.5: (Us waqt) har shakhs apne aage bheje hue aur peechhe chhode hue (yaani agle pichhle aamaal) ko maaloom kar lega.
ayahs.6: Ae insaan! Tujhe apne Rabb-e-kareem se kis cheez ne behkaaya.
ayahs.7: Jis (Rabb ne) tujhe paida kiya, phir theek-thaak kiya, phir (durust aur) baraabar banaaya.
ayahs.8: Jis soorat mein chaaha tujhe jod diya.
ayahs.9: Hargiz nahi, balke tum to jaza-o-saza ke din ko jhutlaate ho.
ayahs.10: Yaqeenan tum par nigehbaan izzat wale.
ayahs.12: Jo kuch tum karte ho woh jaante hain.
ayahs.13: Yaqeenan nek log (jannat ke aish-o-aaraam aur) naimaton mein honge.
ayahs.14: Aur yaqeenan bad-kaar log dozakh mein honge.
ayahs.15: Badle wale din is mein jaaenge.
ayahs.16: Woh is se kabhi ghaayab na hone paaenge.
ayahs.17: Tujhe kuch khabar bhi hai ke badle ka din kya hai.
ayahs.18: Main phir (kehta hoon ke) tujhe kya maaloom ke jaza (aur saza) ka din kya hai.
ayahs.19: (Woh hai) jis din koi shakhs kisi shakhs ke liye kisi cheez ka mukhtaar na hoga, aur (tamaam tar) ahkaam us roz Allah ke hi honge.
